content.query:
select * 
from om.om_task_dependency OTD
LEFT JOIN
om.om_task_run OTR
ON
OTR.TASK_NAME=OTD.TASK_NAME
AND OTR.STATUS_ID='3'
---AND OTR.PROCESS_DATE='2023-03-21'
where OTD.dependent_task_name like '%CI_TRUST_RETAIL%'

INSERT INTO
OM.OM_TASK_RUN
SELECT 
DEPENDENCY_ID,'TSK_EDS_TRU_CUST' TASK_NAME,DEPENDENT_TASK_NAME,MONTHEND,TASK_RUN_ID,TASK_NAME,PIPELINE_RUNID,STATUS_ID,DATA_LAYER
,'2023-03-21' PROCESS_DATE,START_DATETIME,END_DATETIME,CREATE_DATETIME,TGT_RECCOUNT
346,TSK_EDS_TRU_PORTFOLIO,TSK_CI_TRUST_RETAIL
FROM OM.OM_TASK_RUN
WHERE TASK_NAME='TSK_EDS_TRU_BASELINK'
